admission.justification: A page that no index links is invisible to a reader and silently rots; the check measures reach from the one documentation index.

conditions: A page is reached by a link from docs/README.md, directly or through one index page.
A file that is no page is reached when a link from docs/README.md reaches it, or when the front page README.md shows or links it by a relative path.
statement: A file under docs/ that is no page counts as reached when the front page README.md shows or links it by a relative path; a page under docs/ must be reached from docs/README.md directly or through one index page, and a file under docs/ that neither a link from docs/README.md reaches nor the front page shows is reported as unreached.
